tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Get key facts about this photo-printing service: brand name, countries served, customer rating, paper, and delivery time.

tools.name: get_photo_print_pricing
tools.description: Get per-photo price tiers for photo printing. Optionally filter by a size string such as '10x15' or '20x30'.

size.description: Optional size to filter by, e.g. '10x15'. Omit to return pricing for all sizes.

tools.name: list_photo_print_sizes
tools.description: List every available photo print size (in cm) with a short description of each.

tools.name: open_photo_order
tools.description: Open the photo ordering app in the current tab so the user can upload photos and place an order. Does not place any order itself.
